name: Aaron's (lease-to-own)
notes: Researched from Aaron's public FAQ, EZPay and Contact Us pages only; the MyAccount sign-in (login.aarons.com) renders by script and showed no fields when loaded, so the sign-in steps and MFA are not observed. The site's header sign-in asks for Email Address and Password, so the identifier is modelled as email (inferred for MyAccount). Online payments are made in MyAccount (myaccount.aarons.com or the app; Sign Up to create access; Need help logging in? then Forgot password? to reset; locked-out customers call 1-888-333-3785). EZPay, Aaron's recurring payment program, can be set up online in MyAccount or the app with a debit or credit card (the EZPay page and the Contact Us Make a Payment link: Pay online or set up EZPay; participating stores only), on a weekly, bi-weekly, semi-monthly or monthly schedule with a reminder before each payment. The older FAQ answer says to sign up through the local store; the EZPay page is the more specific source. EZPay is card-only. EZPay can be changed or cancelled any time in MyAccount, at 1-855-455-8777 (EZPay page) or 800-950-7368 (FAQ); cancelling EZPay does not end the lease. Payment arrangements are made with the local store. Customers who cannot keep paying may return the merchandise through the local store (owing only past-due payments) and later reinstate it under Lifetime Reinstatement (some exclusions; must reapply). Same As Cash (generally 120 days; 90 days in California) and the Early Purchase Option are explained in the lease. Stores accept cash, checks, money orders and major cards; a first payment made online must be by debit or credit card. No application or processing fee. Customer service 1-800-950-7368 (Mon-Sat 9am-10pm, Sun 10am-8pm ET). Paperless, fees and late fees are not described publicly. Integrated 2026-10-09: billing.methods ['card']: no saved checking account; generated tasks use the saved Visa.

payment_arrangement.note: Payment arrangements are not made online. Contact your local Aaron's store to make one, or call Customer Service at 1-800-950-7368 to discuss your options.

cancel_service.note: Leases are not ended online. Contact your local Aaron's store to arrange a return of the merchandise; if you are current, you owe no further lease payments.

help.title: Making payments
paragraphs: To pay online, go to MyAccount, choose Sign Up and follow the instructions to set up access, then make your payments there or in the app.

Most Aaron's stores accept cash, checks, money orders and all major credit cards. If you started your lease online, the first payment must be made with a debit or credit card; after that you can pay in store or keep paying online.
Aaron's only drafts your bank account with your authorization, such as when you enroll in EZPay or make online payments in MyAccount.
steps: Sign Up for online access if you haven't already.
Log in and choose the lease to pay.

help.title: Set up EZPay automatic payments
paragraphs: EZPay is Aaron's recurring payment program. Have a debit or credit card ready, then open MyAccount online or in the Aaron's app (create your online account first if you have never paid online) and choose EZPay. It is offered at participating stores.

Pick a weekly, bi-weekly, semi-monthly or monthly schedule. You get a reminder before each payment, and your card is charged on the dates and amounts you authorized. If a card payment is declined, you need to pay another way to stay on time.
steps: Log in to MyAccount or create an account.
Enter your debit or credit card.

help.title: Cancel or update EZPay
paragraphs: You can change or cancel your EZPay schedule at any time in MyAccount or by calling 1-855-455-8777 (the FAQ also lists 800-950-7368 and your local store). You get an email confirming the change.
Cancelling EZPay does not end your lease: you still need to renew your lease on each renewal date by paying another way.
steps: Update the schedule or select Cancel.

help.title: Payment and account questions
paragraphs: Forgot your password? On MyAccount select Need help logging in?, then Forgot password?. If you are locked out, call 1-888-333-3785.
To make a payment arrangement, contact your local store.
Aaron's does not charge an application or processing fee.
If you can no longer afford your payments, call Customer Service at 1-800-950-7368 to discuss options.

help.title: Same As Cash and Early Purchase Option
paragraphs: For new agreements with an ownership plan longer than 6 months, paying out the merchandise within the Same As Cash period means paying only the cash price plus tax and any fees. The period varies by location but is generally 120 days; in California it is 90 days for all agreements.

After Same As Cash expires you can use the Early Purchase Option, which costs more than the cash price but less than renting for the full plan. Keep making regular payments until you exercise either option.

help.title: Returning merchandise and Lifetime Reinstatement
paragraphs: You can return leased merchandise at any time by contacting your local store to arrange the return. If you are current on payments you owe nothing more; past-due payments are still owed.

Lifetime Reinstatement: when you are ready again, you can restart at the same point in your ownership plan with the same or comparable pre-leased merchandise. You must reapply and be approved, and lawn equipment, air conditioners, seasonal and special-order items are excluded.
